title: 7.20.2 Sub-build: Send an action
description: H hosts, JOIN joins, and 1, 2 or 3 sends that action: every action, yours too, arrives in onMove and is listed on both computers with the seat that sent it.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: The top says Press H to host. H and the number keys do nothing yet. (Before you host or join, `online.code` and `online.seat` hold nothing, so the top shows the hint instead of them.)

steps.title: Listen for actions
steps.instructions: In `setup()`, set up `online.onMove((m, seat) => { if ([1, 2, 3].includes(m.act)) got.push('seat ' + seat + ': ' + NAMES[m.act]); });`. Below it, join a room when there is a code: `if (JOIN !== '') online.join(JOIN);`.
hints: `onMove` goes in `setup()`: it is set once, and then runs for every move.
`[1, 2, 3].includes(m.act)` skips a move that is not one of the three actions, so `NAMES[m.act]` always has a word.

steps.title: Host, and send
steps.instructions: In `draw()`, below `background(...)`: `if (kb.presses('h') && online.status === 'off') online.host();`. Then, once the room is ready, send the key you press: `if (online.status === 'ready') { if (kb.presses('1')) online.send({ act: 1 }); if (kb.presses('2')) online.send({ act: 2 }); if (kb.presses('3')) online.send({ act: 3 }); }`. Run, press H, and read the room code at the top.
hints: Sending before the room is `'ready'` stops with an error that says so.
The list is made from `got`, not from the key you pressed: an action appears only once it has come back.

steps.title: Try it with two tabs
steps.instructions: Open this lesson in a second browser tab. Put the code in `JOIN` there and Run. Both tabs now say Ready. Press 1, 2 or 3 in either one: the action appears in both lists, with seat 0 for the host and seat 1 for the other tab.
hints: You must be signed in and in a class. A seat is your account in one tab, so each tab gets its own seat.

aiCheck.rubricTitle: What the AI read in your code
aiCheck.prompt: The student wrote a moSHion sketch for "Sub-build: Send an action". The task: set up online.onMove once in setup() so each arriving action (1, 2 or 3) is added to got with the seat that sent it; join when JOIN has a code; host on H while the status is 'off'; once the room is 'ready', keys 1, 2 and 3 send { act: 1 }, { act: 2 } or { act: 3 } with online.send. Accept any names, helpers, ternaries, nested ifs, switch statements and semicolons; a line only in a comment or string does not count. Short, plain notes for a 14-year-old; never write corrected code.
